objects.description: During the [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024), [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) created tokens using compromised SAML signing certificates.(Citation: Microsoft - Customer Guidance on Recent Nation-State Cyber Attacks)(Citation: Secureworks IRON RITUAL Profile)
objects.description_fa: در طول [SolarWinds Compromise](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0024)، [APT29](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0016) نشانه‌هایی را با استفاده از گواهی‌های امضای SAML در معرض خطر ایجاد کرد.(Citation: Microsoft - Customer Guidance on Recent Nation-State Cyber Attacks)[[CTI_PRESERVE_1] (Citation: Secureworks IRON RITUAL Profile)
